content.introduction: The latest U.S. inflation figures show that consumer prices continued to rise in August 2026, with the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increasing 0.4% in August on a seasonally adjusted basis. Over the 12 months through August, overall consumer prices increased 3.4%, unchanged from July. However, the September 2026 report from Trading Economics indicates that the US annual inflation rate accelerated to 3.7% in September 2026, up from 3.4% in each of the previous two months, driven by higher energy prices. The next U.S. CPI report, covering September 2026, is scheduled for October 14, 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
body:
The latest U.S. inflation figures show that consumer prices continued to rise in August 2026. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased 0.4% in August on a seasonally adjusted basis. Over the 12 months through August, overall consumer prices increased 3.4%. This annual inflation rate was unchanged from July, meaning inflation remained at the same yearly pace even though prices moved higher during the month. [...] For now, the latest data show a 3.4% annual headline inflation rate, while core inflation stands at 2.4%. Future reports will help show whether price pressures continue at a similar pace or begin moving higher or lower. Consumers, businesses, and policymakers will continue watching categories such as energy, shelter, food, and other services to understand how the inflation picture develops through the remainder of 2026.

### Q1. What is the US inflation rate? [...] The August 2026 CPI report was released on September 11, 2026. The next U.S. CPI report, covering September 2026, is scheduled for October 14, 2026, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

## The US annual inflation rate accelerated to 3.7% in September 2026, up from 3.4% in each of the previous two months and above market expectations of 3.6%, driven by higher energy prices. Gasoline rose 34.2% yoy, more than 27.4% in August and fuel oil prices increased 74.2%, compared with 52% previously. Inflation also accelerated for shelter, to 3.2% from 3%, but slowed for food to 2.5% from 2.7%. # US Inflation Rate 2026: Current CPI Data

Latest reading: US annual inflation was 3.7% for the 12 months ending September 2026, released by the Bureau of Labor Statistics on 12 August 2026. Core CPI, which strips out food and energy, rose 2.5% over the same period. The next release, covering August 2026, is scheduled for 11 September 2026. [...] The annual rate eased from 3.5% to 3.4% in the July report, continuing a gradual cooling from the 2022 peak. Month-to-month movements are small and can reverse, so a single reading is not a trend.

### What is the Federal Reserve’s target?

The Fed targets 2% inflation over the longer run, measured using the PCE price index rather than CPI. PCE typically runs slightly below CPI.
